images.caption:
Oak Island is a 57-hectare (140-acre) privately owned island. The tree-covered island is one of about 360 small islands in Mahone Bay. The island is located 200 meters (660 feet) from shore and connected to the mainland by a causeway and gate. This is as far as I could go, this old cannon is at the entrance of the causeway.
The island is best known for various theories about possible buried treasure or historical artifacts, and the associated explorations. For more than a century and a half, there have been various groups of people looking for treasure on Oak Island.
